text: After this you can justify the breadth of the next review from the available evidence.

For education only; this is not legal, purchasing, financial or safety advice. After recording major gaps, decide how much further analysis is justified. A large or uncertain problem may warrant a broad review; a narrow, well-understood gap may support a smaller study. Document the reasons, what remains outside scope and which owner must approve the route. The stages in this lesson are illustrative and do not replace an organization’s actual approval process.

items: Inferred: A focused review can be suitable when one measurable shortfall is well understood, but the decision owner must accept its limits.

text: Use evidence about the shortfalls to justify the next analysis route.
The controlling applicability criteria and decision authority may require a different route.
